words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}) opens the ayah as a completed plural speech act: the brothers answer together, and the single reporting verb governs the whole oath-recognition-confession unit. That makes their words public acknowledgment rather than private realization. Within that speech, God is invoked as oath witness and then named as the actor of Joseph's elevation, so the saying becomes sworn testimony about God's own action. The opening also reverses earlier brother-speech patterns: the oath formula that once denied wrongdoing now carries confession (12:73), and this self-indicting speech will be repeated before their father (12:97). Even the q-l onset prepares the l-heavy oath-and-certainty cadence that follows.

topics.headline: collective speech frames one confession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers answer as a single completed speaking group whose whole utterance is oath, recognition, and confession.
topics.reason: The perfect 3mp speech verb governs the full quoted complement, and the attachment evidence makes words 2-13 one reported utterance.

topics.headline: speech becomes sworn testimony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that this is not casual dialogue; the speech verb launches a formal declaration in which God is invoked and then named as actor.
topics.reason: The local quote names God first as oath witness and later as preferring agent, giving the saying-root field a concrete sworn-testimony role.

topics.headline: same voices reverse into confession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the brothers reuse speech and oath patterns that once carried denial, now turned into acknowledgment and repeated confession (12:73; 12:97).
topics.reason: The cited same-surah parallels support a moral speech arc: earlier deflection and oath-denial become recognition before Joseph and later confession before their father.

topics.headline: sound carries speech into oath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the opening speech consonants prepare the compact oath-and-certainty cadence that follows.
topics.reason: The sound claim is local and modest: it supports the transition from the speech verb into the following oath particles without controlling syntax.

words.prose: {{ar:تَ}} ({{tr:ta}}) begins the oath frame with the restricted oath particle attached to the divine name. Its scope reaches the response claim, so Joseph's elevation is sworn rather than merely asserted. The accepted variant with a regular oath preposition shows that the referent and claim remain stable while the canonical dental onset keeps a sharper, clipped, compressed family-oath register, recalling the earlier oath formula (12:73).

topics.headline: restricted oath governs the claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recognition of Joseph is sworn under a restricted divine-name oath, not merely stated after an exclamation.
topics.reason: The particle {{ar:تَ}} ({{tr:ta}}) is locally attached to the divine name and the following response clause supplies the oath answer.

topics.headline: compressed formula without spoken oath verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a compact oath formula whose force comes from particle plus divine name rather than an overt verb of swearing.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence licenses formulaic ellipsis, and the same-surah oath register at 12:73 makes the family speech pattern visible.

topics.reason: The variant can illuminate recitation texture and particle choice, but it does not replace the canonical local surface or alter the local oath scope.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:llāhi}}) completes the oath object as the proper divine name in genitive relation to the oath particle. The name is not a generic deity label; it fixes the confession before the named witness, with worship-and-awe resonance kept as a narrowed background. The same referent will soon appear as the agent of preferring, so the brothers swear by God and then acknowledge God's action, echoing divine-favor language in the surah (12:38; 12:90).

topics.headline: proper name fixes the oath witness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the oath is fastened to the proper divine name as a genitive oath object, making the confession answerable to the named witness.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence agree that the proper noun is governed by the oath particle as the oath object.

topics.headline: name field adds awe without changing referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can keep the worship-and-awe resonance of the divine name while still reading the local word as the proper name in an oath slot.
topics.reason: The root-dispute rows are useful as resonance, but local grammar selects the proper divine name as oath object rather than a generic deity noun.

topics.headline: witness and actor are the same referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers swear by the same God whom they soon name as Joseph’s preferring agent, echoing earlier divine-favor language (12:38; 12:90).
topics.reason: The same divine name appears first in the oath and then as the subject of the preference verb, while the cited same-surah parallels support the favor-to-preference movement.

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) marks the answer side of the oath before the certainty particle. It prevents the oath from floating as a formula and welds it to the coming preference claim. In the compact sequence with {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}), the clipped {{ar:لَقَدْ}} ({{tr:laqad}}) cadence places two confirmation beats before the verb arrives, so the brothers' reversal is grammatically linked, confirmed, and emphatic.

topics.headline: response prefix links oath to answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the oath is not left hanging; this prefix marks the following preference claim as the oath’s answer.
topics.reason: The prefix {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) precedes the certainty particle and structurally links the oath to {{ar:ءَاثَرَكَ}} ({{tr:ātharaka}}) as sworn content.

topics.headline: compact certainty stack
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the claim tighten before the verb through a compact pair of confirmation devices attached at the start of the answer clause.
topics.reason: The row family coherently describes the written and sounded compression of the response prefix with the certainty particle.

words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) places completed certainty directly before the perfect verb {{ar:ءَاثَرَكَ}} ({{tr:ātharaka}}). The brothers are conceding that God's preference has already happened and is not a possible future, wish, or contested claim. Inside the oath-answer sequence, it carries the heightened register from sworn formula into the main verb of recognition.

topics.headline: completed certainty before the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers concede an accomplished divine fact, not a possible future or a negotiable claim.
topics.reason: The certainty particle {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) immediately precedes the perfect verb {{ar:ءَاثَرَكَ}} ({{tr:ātharaka}}), licensing completed certainty.

topics.headline: oath answer and certainty arrive together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how the oath frame transfers into the main verb through a fused answer-and-certainty unit.
topics.reason: The particle is locally part of the compact answer formula after the oath, and the boundary rows support a carryover of emphatic register from 12:90.

words.gloss_range: directed divine preferring of Joseph with attached second-person object
words.root_gloss_range: preference, giving priority, and trace or vestige imagery; locally Form IV preferring with a marked object and comparison frame

words.prose: {{ar:ءَاثَرَكَ}} ({{tr:ātharaka}}) carries the core confession: Joseph is fused to the verb as the second-person object, God will be named as the subject, and {{ar:عَلَيْنَا}} ({{tr:ʿalaynā}}) supplies the comparison group. Form IV presents active directed selection, not accidental advantage. The root's trace field remains as narrowed imagery: divine preference leaves Joseph visibly marked, while the local sense stays preferring; the root's rarity in this verbal configuration makes the admission more marked. The verb also answers earlier rivalry over Joseph (12:8) and joins wider preference contrasts (59:9; 20:72). Its initial hamza and long ā make the move from short oath particles into the main admission audible.

topics.headline: preference has object, agent, and comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the whole frame: Joseph is the attached object, God is the later explicit subject, and the brothers are the comparison group.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the object suffix, subject, and prepositional complement as the local valency frame of the verb.

topics.headline: Form IV makes preference active selection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the brothers confess deliberate divine selection rather than vague good fortune or ordinary rank.
topics.reason: The local form tag is PV:IV with a clitic object and comparison phrase, matching the CRITICAL claim of directed preferring.

topics.headline: preference carries trace imagery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can sense preference as a visible mark left on Joseph, while the local clause still selects preferring as the governing sense.
topics.reason: The trace-root rows are coherent and not contradicted, but they should color the selected preference sense rather than replace it with a physical trace meaning.

topics.headline: human preference patterns are overturned
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Joseph’s elevation answer earlier rivalry (12:8) and stand beside wider preference language where humans either prefer others (59:9) or refuse false preference (20:72).
topics.reason: The cited references support contrast and echo without controlling the local syntax: here God is the preferring agent and Joseph the object.

topics.headline: verb onset marks the shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the clause move from short oath particles into the decisive preference verb.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local and supports the transition into the main admission without adding a separate lexical sense.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:llāhu}}) resolves the delayed actor of the preference verb. The clause first gives the action and Joseph-object, then lands on the proper divine name as nominative subject, making divine agency unavoidable in the brothers' wording. The worship-and-awe resonance of the name colors the named agent, while the local grammar keeps the function as explicit subject of the preference verb. The same name has already served as oath witness, so the ayah encloses the claim with God as both guarantor and actor, continuing the boundary from divine bestowal in 12:90 into divine selection here.

topics.headline: delayed subject names the actor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause first hears the preference and Joseph-object, then lands on God as the explicit actor.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify this word as the nominative subject following the verb-object sequence.

topics.headline: same name moves from witness to actor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the divine name change grammatical role inside one ayah: oath witness at the opening, preferring agent at the center.
topics.reason: The same proper name appears in two cases and two roles, genitive oath object and nominative subject.

topics.headline: awe-field colors the named agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can retain worship-and-awe resonance around the divine name while keeping the local function as explicit agent of preference.
topics.reason: The root-dispute claim enriches the divine name but does not alter the local agent role.

topics.headline: bestower becomes selector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects Joseph’s prior mention of divine bestowal with the brothers’ admission of divine selection (12:90).
topics.reason: The 12:90 boundary echo is concrete and locally relevant because both clauses name God with a related favor or selection frame.

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْنَا}} ({{tr:ʿalaynā}}) closes the preference clause by making the brothers themselves the comparison group: God preferred Joseph over us. The preposition's overness gives the comparison spatial pressure, while the local grammar keeps it as the governed comparison after the preference verb. The pronoun also reverses the value of earlier favor language: the sound of us continues, but now it names the passed-over speakers (12:38; 12:90). Its -nā sound will return in {{ar:كُنَّا}} ({{tr:kunnā}}), binding the brothers as both the surpassed group and the confessing group.

topics.headline: comparison lands on the speakers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers do not make an abstract claim about Joseph; they confess that God preferred him over them.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the pronoun suffix the complement of the comparison preposition governed by the preference verb.

topics.headline: overness gives comparison spatial pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the comparative over-us wording as superiority placed above the brothers, while local grammar keeps comparison as the selected function.
topics.reason: The broader upon or against pressures may color the confession, but the governed comparison after the preference verb is the local syntactic role.

topics.headline: same pronoun shape reverses value
topics.reader_payoff: The reader catches the social reversal: the sound of “us” continues from favor language, but in this clause it names the passed-over brothers (12:38; 12:90).
topics.reason: The cited same-surah uses support a boundary inversion without changing the local pronoun reference, which remains the speaking brothers.

topics.headline: sound binds surpassed group to confessing group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same group sound return when the speakers move from being surpassed to confessing guilt.
topics.reason: The sound claim is local to the repeated first-person plural ending and reinforces the speakers’ continuing identity across the two clauses.

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots from recognition to self-indictment. It keeps the final clause connected to the same speech act while preserving it as a second declaration: God preferred Joseph, and the brothers were culpable. Its additive force is secure, and its circumstantial or concessive coloring is useful as nuance because the guilt clause stands as the background against which the recognition now becomes honest. The short entry into {{ar:وَإِن}} ({{tr:wa-in}}) makes the turn into confession arrive quickly after the preference claim.

topics.headline: conjunction turns recognition into self-indictment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the turn from God’s act toward Joseph to the brothers’ own verdict on themselves.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the copular confession to the preceding preference assertion inside the same quotation.

topics.headline: confession remains a second declaration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the brothers make two claims, not one: Joseph has been preferred, and they were culpable.
topics.reason: The local clause analysis treats words 9-13 as a coordinated copular confession, preserving it as a distinct declaration.

topics.headline: background guilt accompanies recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the final clause as added confession and as the guilty state against which the recognition now stands.
topics.reason: Additive coordination is syntactically secure; circumstantial or concessive force is a useful local nuance but should not erase the second-clause structure.

topics.headline: clipped turn into confession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the confession arrive quickly after the preference claim through a short connector-particle entry.
topics.reason: The sound row adds local cadence payoff without creating a separate grammatical parse.

words.gloss_range: lightened emphatic particle, locally disambiguated away from condition by the later predicate prefix

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: lightened emphatic particle disambiguated by predicate prefix

words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) opens the confession with a surface that could look conditional in isolation, but the later predicate prefix forces the lightened emphatic reading. That means the brothers are not saying if we were culpable; the grammar blocks the hypothetical escape and turns the clause into confirmed self-indictment. The nasal n of the short particle also binds directly into the first-person plural state verb that follows.

topics.headline: ambiguous surface is locked as affirmation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form could look conditional in isolation, but the later predicate prefix shuts that door and makes the confession emphatic.
topics.reason: QAC explicitly marks the particle as lightened emphasis here, not a conditional, because the predicate carries the distinguishing prefix.

topics.headline: particle launches the copular confession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final clause open as a reinforced state confession, carrying the ayah’s certainty register into self-indictment.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the copular clause in which the past state verb and active participle predicate form the final confession.

topics.headline: sound fuses particle to state verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the emphatic particle bind into the first-person plural state verb at the start of the confession.
topics.reason: The nasal sound observation is local and supports the felt cohesion of the particle-copula sequence.

words.gloss_range: first-person plural past copula making guilt a confessed state

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first-person plural past copula

words.prose: {{ar:كُنَّا}} ({{tr:kunnā}}) makes the guilt a state of the speakers. The first-person plural ending places the brothers grammatically inside the confessed condition, and the following participial predicate makes this an identity-style confession rather than a report of one event. The broader being-and-position field lets the confession feel like a moral station they occupy, while the local verb remains the copula. The past form looks back over an established guilty condition while leaving its moral force open, and the same copular guilt shape returns in the surah's confession cluster (12:29; 12:79; 12:97).

topics.headline: copula makes guilt a state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers do not merely report a sinning event; they predicate culpable identity of themselves.
topics.reason: The local construction is a past copula with an active-participle predicate, not a finite verb of sinning.

topics.headline: speakers are grammatically inside the state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the brothers attach themselves to the confessed condition through the first-person plural verb ending.
topics.reason: The verb morphology supplies first-person plural agreement controlled by the speakers inside the quote.

topics.headline: past state keeps moral weight open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the past-state form looks back over guilt without by itself proving whether the moral condition is fully closed.
topics.reason: The perfect copular form licenses past-state confession; claims about whether guilt remains must be kept as interpretive scope, not grammatical certainty.

topics.headline: being field gives moral station pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the confession as locating the brothers in a moral station, while the local verb still functions as the copula.
topics.reason: The broader root field of being and position is relevant as pressure, but the local selected function is copular predication.

topics.headline: copular guilt formula recurs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the brothers’ confession as part of a same-surah formula that returns before their father (12:29; 12:97) and contrasts Joseph’s hypothetical injustice language (12:79).
topics.reason: The cited parallels support a recurring copula-plus-moral-predicate shape without overriding the local predicate.

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is the distinguishing and emphatic prefix that locks the final predicate. After {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}), it defeats a conditional reading and makes the confession definite rather than evasive. Because it is attached directly to {{ar:خَٰطِـِٔينَ}} ({{tr:khāṭiʾīna}}), the grammatical disambiguation lands on the guilt word itself, completing the particle-copula-predicate chain.

topics.headline: prefix defeats the hypothetical escape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the confession cannot be softened into “if we were sinners”; this prefix locks it as an affirmed self-verdict.
topics.reason: QAC marks this as the distinguishing prefix placed on the predicate of the lightened emphatic construction.

topics.headline: the lock is carried by the guilt word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the disambiguating and reinforcing marker is attached directly to the predicate that names their guilt.
topics.reason: The prefix is placed on the predicate word, making the grammatical lock and moral label arrive as one unit.

topics.headline: particle-copula-prefix triple closes the clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final confession built from a coordinated stack: emphatic particle, past copula, and predicate-locking prefix.
topics.reason: The row accurately describes the local sequence as a layered grammar of emphatic past-identity confession.

words.prose: {{ar:خَٰطِـِٔينَ}} ({{tr:khāṭiʾīna}}) closes the ayah with a plural active-participle predicate. The brothers classify the whole speaking group as culpable agents, not as people who merely committed one accidental error. The root's missing-the-mark image remains under moral fault, and the active participle refuses the softer finite-verb alternative. Variant and sound evidence can change the heard texture, especially the hamza catch in the guilt word and the no-hamza variant, but not the confessional predicate. The label also opens the forgiveness arc in the next ayah (12:92) and returns in the brothers' later confession (12:97), while linking to severe guilt parallels (12:29; 28:8). Its relative rarity makes the closing self-label marked rather than routine confession vocabulary.

topics.headline: plural predicate classifies the whole group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word does not name one culprit or one event; it classifies the whole speaking group as culpable agents.
topics.reason: The word is a masculine plural active participle functioning as the predicate of the first-person plural copula.

topics.headline: word choice refuses mere accident
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the brothers choose a culpable active-participle self-label rather than a softer report that they merely made a mistake.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows consistently distinguish culpable sinner identity from accidental error or a finite event report, and no guardrail evidence contradicts that local force.

topics.headline: sound texture changes without changing confession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant and sound evidence can alter the heard texture of the guilt word while preserving the same confessional predicate.
topics.reason: The variant and sound rows are valid as recitational texture, but they do not change the local predicate meaning or grammar.

topics.headline: guilt word opens the forgiveness arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final guilt label prepare the next ayah’s forgiveness response and the later repeated confession (12:92; 12:97).
topics.reason: The cited forward and same-surah references make the confession part of a guilt-to-forgiveness arc without importing the next ayah into the local grammar.

topics.headline: same guilt form links severe scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the brothers’ self-label join other serious culpability labels, including the same-surah accusation in 12:29 and the grave label in 28:8.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows give concrete parallels for the same active-participle label while leaving the present speakers as the local referent.

topics.headline: rare label makes the confession marked
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this active-participle guilt vocabulary is not ordinary filler; its relative rarity makes the closing self-label stand out.
topics.reason: The row counts mark the root and active-participle form as limited but not unique, supporting markedness without overclaiming exclusivity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قالوا تالله لقد آثرك الله علينا وإن كنا لخاطئين
baseline_models.mechanism: The uttered oath assigns the comparison's agent to God: Joseph is deliberately preferred, while the speakers counter-position themselves as culpable.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech makes the recognition public rather than merely inward.
The divine name carries both the oath form and the named agency of selection.
Preferential choosing supplies the explicit comparative relation between Joseph and the speakers.
Culpable sin turns the comparison into confession rather than envy alone.

changed_reading.before: They say that God favored Joseph and that they were wrong.
changed_reading.after: They issue a sworn public verdict: God's preference is legitimate, and the comparative 'over us' is paired with their acceptance of culpable agency.

baseline_models.mechanism: The past-state construction holds two live root branches together: failure to hit the right course and intentional wrongdoing. Neither pure accident nor a timeless evil identity exhausts the confession.

activation_trace.role: Past occurrence locates wrongdoing as an established condition in their history.
Missing the right direction preserves a reading of failed judgment and mis-aim.
Deliberate sin prevents mis-aim from becoming an exculpatory accident.

changed_reading.after: We were living out a wrongly aimed course for which we were nevertheless culpable.

baseline_models.mechanism: The root's surviving-mark branch and the speech root's indication branch allow preference to be read not only as rank but as a conclusion drawn from effects that have become legible.

activation_trace.role: A remaining mark supplies an evidentiary underside to the explicit act of preference.
Speech as indication makes their statement point beyond itself to what the outcome shows.

changed_reading.before: God assigned Joseph a higher rank.
changed_reading.after: God's preference has left effects clear enough that the brothers' speech reads them aloud as evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact group-oath opening recurs with its direction reversed: the speakers first use it to pronounce another person's ruin, then use it to acknowledge their own fault and another's elevation.

activation_trace.role: The earlier group utterance supplies the same public speech frame used in the focus.
The earlier divine-name oath establishes the formula whose evaluative direction will reverse.
The repeated group utterance now externalizes self-judgment.
The repeated oath now ratifies divine preference rather than a prediction against the father.

structural_cues: 12:85 and 12:91 share the opening قالوا تالله; the former predicts the father's ruin, while the latter turns judgment onto the speakers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact formula recurrence and opposed predications; I infer a rhetorical reversal from judging another to confessing self. The recurrence could alternatively be only a habitual emphatic idiom.

changed_reading.before: The oath merely intensifies a spontaneous admission.
changed_reading.after: The oath reenacts and overturns the brothers' earlier speech posture: the same emphatic instrument that policed another now authenticates their self-indictment.

context_deltas.mechanism: An appraisal once held inward and not disclosed returns as the brothers' own disclosed description of themselves. The focus confession completes an inside-to-outside movement without Joseph having to voice the charge at them.

activation_trace.role: Concealment in the interior supplies the withheld pole of the disclosure sequence.
The negated act of bringing something into view marks what Joseph did not disclose to them.
Description as showing a thing in its attributes frames the brothers' accusatory speech as answerable description.
Their voiced statement moves the formerly withheld moral assessment into public speech.
Their own culpability term supplies the content of the now self-applied assessment.

structural_cues: 12:77 sequences inward concealment, non-disclosure, and a warning about what the brothers describe.
12:91 lets the same group state its own culpability without an accusation from Joseph in the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, non-disclosure, description, and later self-confession; I infer a directional arc from withheld appraisal to self-disclosure. The scenes may instead be linked only by broad dramatic irony.

changed_reading.after: The brothers themselves bring to speech the moral verdict that had remained concealed, turning prior description of others into exposure of self.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier the speakers delimit testimony by present knowledge, invoke what is hidden, and seek external confirmation of truthful speech. Their focus utterance now functions as testimony against their own interest, based on what has become known.

activation_trace.role: Testimony as informed declaration supplies the legal-evidentiary speech frame.
Knowledge as disclosure bounds their earlier claim to what had become apparent.
Hiddenness marks the earlier limit the speakers place on their responsibility as witnesses.
Truthful speech supplies the standard for which they had previously sought external corroboration.
The focus utterance becomes the vehicle of testimony once recognition removes the prior epistemic limit.
Self-attributed guilt makes this testimony adverse to the speakers' own standing.

structural_cues: 12:81 limits witness to known facts and disclaims custody of the hidden; 12:82 summons village and caravan as corroboration.
After recognition in 12:90, 12:91 requires no outside witness for the speakers' self-incriminating conclusion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring witness, knowledge, hiddenness, truth, and speech; I infer that the focus utterance carries evidentiary force as an admission against interest. It may remain an affective exclamation rather than a quasi-legal testimony.

changed_reading.before: The brothers voice an emotional moral admission.
changed_reading.after: The brothers become witnesses against themselves: newly disclosed knowledge produces the corroboration their earlier speech had sought outside itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joseph's immediately prior question points to concrete action and names the actors' condition as ignorance; the brothers answer with the stronger self-designation of culpable mis-aim. Ignorance remains explanatory but is not allowed to erase agency.

activation_trace.role: The enacted deed gives the confession a concrete behavioral object rather than an abstract bad identity.
Lack of knowledge supplies an explanatory reading of their earlier condition.
Disturbed restraint and impulsive temperament supply a second, affective account of that ignorance.
Failure to hit the right course answers the ignorance diagnosis without reducing it to information alone.
Culpable wrongdoing intensifies Joseph's diagnosis into the speakers' assumption of responsibility.

structural_cues: 12:89 asks what they did and temporally locates it in their ignorance; recognition intervenes in 12:90; 12:91 supplies their answer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deed, ignorance, recognition, and self-named error; I infer a reclassification from explanatory ignorance to owned culpability. A live alternative is that the two labels are simple synonyms at different levels of politeness.

changed_reading.before: They confess a general state of being wrong.
changed_reading.after: They answer for a concrete deed, accepting culpability while preserving ignorance and ungoverned judgment as explanations rather than excuses.

context_deltas.mechanism: Meager tender, full measure, charity, and recompense form an economy of disproportion. Against it, preference reads as a divine allocation exceeding exchange, while the self-appropriation branch marks the alternative of hoarding the good for oneself.

activation_trace.role: The small, deficient offering supplies the low side of an unequal exchange.
Completion without deficiency supplies the requested excess over what their tender can command.
Measured food makes allocation materially visible rather than merely honorific.
Recompense introduces a moral account of return alongside commercial measure.
Preferential choosing names the asymmetry the brothers now recognize.
Self-exclusive appropriation supplies the nearby negative alternative from which named divine allocation is distinguished.

structural_cues: In 12:88 the brothers bring inadequate goods, ask for full measure and charity, and invoke divine recompense; in 12:91 they name divine preference.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deficit, fullness, measure, recompense, and preference; I infer that the material economy activates a moral economy of disproportionate gift. The commercial vocabulary may instead remain local scene-setting with no semantic pressure on 12:91.

changed_reading.before: Preference is a bare hierarchy of persons.
changed_reading.after: Preference is perceived through an asymmetrical economy: Joseph's portion cannot be explained by exchange, yet divine allocation is distinguished from selfish monopoly.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding account joins unpriced gift to protection, restraint, non-loss, and reward. The brothers' statement can therefore interpret preference as the visible preservation and return of a course maintained under trial, not arbitrary favoritism.

activation_trace.role: A grant released without equivalent payment supplies the gift side of Joseph's account.
Protective avoidance supplies one maintained disposition linked to the outcome.
Restraint of the self supplies the enduring disposition paired with protection.
The denial of loss frames the outcome as something preserved rather than accidentally found.
Reward for work supplies a causal account the brothers can apply to the preference they name next.
Preferential choosing states the outcome whose moral mechanism the preceding sentence makes legible.

structural_cues: 12:90 places gift, protective conduct, patience, non-loss, and reward immediately before the brothers' acknowledgment of preference in 12:91.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies Joseph's general causal maxim immediately before the admission; I infer that the brothers' next utterance reads his elevation through that maxim. They may instead acknowledge only the outcome without endorsing a merit-based explanation.

changed_reading.before: God simply favored Joseph over his brothers.
changed_reading.after: The brothers recognize in Joseph's elevation the non-loss of protected, patient conduct, while still naming its source as divine gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two adjacent first-person plurals draw different circles: Joseph joins himself with his brother under divine gift, then the other brothers place Joseph across from themselves under divine preference. Their confession is also an acceptance of a reordered fraternity.

activation_trace.role: Brotherhood and kinship name the bond inside Joseph's preceding first-person plural.
The unpriced grant falls upon Joseph's stated 'us' and gives that group boundary theological weight.
Preference places Joseph opposite the speakers' different 'us' without canceling the kinship relation.

structural_cues: 12:90 says 'this is my brother' and 'God bestowed upon us'; 12:91 answers that God preferred 'you over us.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent but speaker-dependent plural pronouns and explicit brotherhood; I infer that their juxtaposition redraws the social map and that confession accepts the new ordering. The pronouns may simply have ordinary shifting referents without thematic force.

changed_reading.before: The brothers compare Joseph's status with their own.
changed_reading.after: The comparison renegotiates who can say 'us': the speakers accept Joseph's specially bonded place while beginning to re-enter fraternity through truthful confession.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next response removes blame, asks that sin be covered from its effects, and invokes both tenderness and kinship. The confession is therefore not a terminal sentence upon the speakers but the speech threshold across which culpability can be acknowledged without endless reproach.

activation_trace.role: Culpable sin supplies the real offense that mercy addresses rather than denying.
The explicit removal of blame blocks confession from becoming perpetual humiliation.
Covering the sin while protecting its bearer from its effect supplies the reparative direction.
Tender mercy supplies the affective mode of the immediate answer.
Kinship within the mercy root keeps reconciliation socially anchored in family.

structural_cues: 12:91 ends in self-attributed culpability; 12:92 answers immediately with no reproach, forgiveness, and superlative mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies confession followed by a three-part merciful response; I infer that the response reveals the confession's pragmatic function as an opening to restoration. It could instead be a gracious reaction that does not alter the focus utterance's own force.

changed_reading.before: The brothers condemn themselves at the climax of recognition.
changed_reading.after: The brothers state real guilt at the precise point where truth can replace defensive speech and make non-reproach, protection from sin's effects, and renewed kinship possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surviving-mark branch of preference receives a concrete sequel: a garment is cast onto a face and sight returns. This activates a reading in which divine preference is not only titular rank but an effect-bearing trace that travels outward into restoration.

activation_trace.role: The remaining mark supplies the focus anchor for an effect that can become materially legible.
The worn garment supplies a concrete carrier associated with Joseph.
Casting the carrier supplies the directional transfer from Joseph toward the father.
The face supplies the receiving surface where the transferred sign is applied.
Restored ocular sight supplies the announced outward effect.
Inner discernment keeps physical restoration open to a parallel recognition reading.

structural_cues: After the brothers recognize divine preference in 12:91 and receive no reproach in 12:92, 12:93 sends Joseph's garment toward the father's face with an announced restoration of sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the trace branch and the garment-to-face-to-sight sequence; I supply the arrow that treats the garment as a carrier of the preference's effects. The live alternative is that this is only a subsequent action with no lexical activation of آثرك.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, preference names a marked, transmissible efficacy: Joseph's elevation leaves a trace whose effects move toward restored perception and reunion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the split mapping moves from preference into eruption and displacement. It remains anchored in the packet's non-dominant target for ءاثرك and yields a coherent emergence reading, but downstream prose should call it a latent root activation, not a lexical replacement for 'preferred.'

activation_trace.role: Visible eruption after latency recasts elevation as something brought out of concealment.
Stirring a thing from its place supplies the dynamic arrow from suppressed position to manifested preeminence.

changed_reading.before: God statically ranked Joseph above the speakers.
changed_reading.after: As a contained latent activation, God stirred Joseph's obscured worth into visible ascendancy over those who had held him down.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The rain-missed land image is materially distant from moral confession, but it is directly supplied by the focus root inventory and locks onto the comparative distribution in 'preferred you over us.' Preserve it as an ecological analogy for misdirection and deprivation; do not use it to erase the explicit sin branch.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: آثرك الله علينا وإن كنا لخاطئين

activation_trace.role: Preference supplies a differential distribution in which one recipient is chosen over others.
Ground missed by rain materializes the speakers as those bypassed when benefit reaches elsewhere.
The sin branch contains the ecological analogy by retaining moral responsibility for their condition.

changed_reading.before: They admit that they committed errors while Joseph was preferred.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they name themselves as wrongly oriented, rain-missed ground while divine benefit reaches Joseph, yet they remain responsible for becoming that unreceptive ground.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it uses the non-dominant ق ل ل target behind قالوا. It remains anchored in the packet's split focus inventory and matches the speech act's surrender of status, but it should be rendered only as sound-root pressure beneath the ordinary verb of saying.

activation_trace.role: Littleness and diminished standing color the speakers' public surrender of comparative rank.
Instability and displacement color the utterance as a collapse of their previously fixed posture.
Ordinary voiced speech keeps the outlier anchored in the actual construction.

changed_reading.before: They confidently state a proposition about Joseph and themselves.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root resonance, their saying performs diminishment and loss of footing: speech itself registers the collapse of their former stance.

strongest_changes: The repeated قالوا تالله formula reverses from judging the father to authenticating the speakers' own fault.
The immediate deed-and-ignorance question is answered by a confession that owns culpability without deleting misjudgment as an explanation.
Joseph's preceding gift, protection, patience, non-loss, and reward sequence makes preference legible as preserved outcome rather than arbitrary favoritism.
The following no-reproach, forgiveness, and mercy sequence turns confession from terminal self-condemnation into an opening for restored kinship.
The trace branch of ء ث ر gains an exploratory material sequel in the garment-to-face-to-sight sequence.
summary.what_was_special: Exact formula recurrence, adjacent shifts in first-person plural, and the split branch inventories kept several readings alive at once: juridical testimony, moral reclassification, social reordering, gift economy, evidentiary trace, and carefully contained material or dynamic outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the trace-and-garment model is genuine lexical activation or only narrative resonance.
How strongly خاطئين should hold accidental mis-aim and deliberate sin together rather than privilege the culpable branch.
Whether the measure-and-recompense vocabulary causally reframes preference or remains local scene-setting.
Whether the adjacent plural pronouns deliberately redraw fraternity or merely shift with their speakers.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The old competition is reversed by acknowledged preference and fault.** ء ث ر B001/B005 (putting first; preferring) directly answers the brothers’ early comparison in 12:8, while خ ط ء B001/B002 names their missed right course and culpability. I infer that recognized divine preference dissolves their claim that paternal preference was mere error.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:92 showed acknowledged preference issuing in released reproach rather than triumph, correcting the brothers’ original zero-sum model of favor.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Preference reattributed and the old comparison corrected.** `ء ث ر:B005` is preferring or specially favoring someone. In 12:8 the brothers had made the father’s preference their grievance; here, after recognition and Joseph’s account of divine favor (12:90), they reassign selection to God and join it to confession of their own error. The packet supplies the reversed comparison; I infer that this reattribution breaks the causal story by which paternal love justified violence. *Ātharaka Allāhu ʿalaynā* reads as a correction of the surah’s first fraternal diagnosis.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:100 identifies the realized dream and the subtly composed reunion, giving concrete narrative form to the divine preference the brothers now acknowledge.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi söyleme fiilinin belirli dil bilgisel ortamlarda sanma fiili gibi işletilmesini anlatır. Bu dal, gerçek söz söyleme eylemi değil, bir yargı veya varsayım kuran gramatik kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dil bilgisel sanma kullanımıdır; normal söz söyleme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam non_bare olduğu için tanım özel gramatik kullanımın dışına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Söyleme fiilinin bazı yapılarda sanmak veya varsaymak gibi işleyerek sonraki unsurları ona göre kurduğu dil bilgisel kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, söyleme fiilinin sanma ve varsayma işleviyle kullanılmasıdır.
Kullanım özellikle soru yapısıyla sınırlanır, fakat aktarımda daha geniş bir lehçe uygulaması da anılır.
Kaynak içindeki lehçe notu, soru dışı kullanıma da uzanan özel bir genişleme bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt bu özel dalı tek bir aktarım üzerinden verir; ortaklaştırılacak ayrı bir çok kaynaklı iddia yoktur.

source_details.summary: Tekil aktarım, sanmak gibi işleyen söyleme kullanımını ve soru dışına uzanan lehçe notunu verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Söyleme fiili gerçek konuşma değil, varsayım veya sanma yapısı kurduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Gramatik işlevi ve sanma değerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dil bilgisel açıklamada söyleme fiilinin varsayım değeri kazandığı bağlam için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sanma işlevini ve kullanım açıklamasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşuda epistemik zayıflık ve tahmin içeriği merkezdir; bu dalda dil bilgisel işleyiş merkezdir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تقول إذا أجري مجرى تظن في العمل، وخاصة في الاستفهام، وما ذكر عن بني سليم من إجراء متصرف قلت مجرى الظن في غير الاستفهام.

branches.source_phrase_ar: العرب تجري تقول وحدها في الاستفهام مجرى تظن في العمل (sihah)؛ بنو سليم يجرون متصرف قلت في غير الاستفهام أيضا مجرى الظن (sihah)

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.text: yük kaldırma, yükselme ve yola koyulma
concept_gloss.applicability: Taşıma, yukarı kalkma ve yüklenerek hareket etme çizgilerinin birlikte özetlenmesi gereken kavram haritasında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yük üstlenme, yükselme ve yolculuk için harekete geçme bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin veya başka bir taşıyıcının bir nesnenin ağırlığını üstlenmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yükü kaldırma gücü ile onu fiilen taşıma anlamlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Göğün yükselmesi veya kuşun uçuşa kalkması gibi yukarı yönlü hareket bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yukarı kalkma ile uçuş için yerden ayrılma değerlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun yolculuk yüklerini alarak bulunduğu yerden ayrılması bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Yük alma, ayrılma ve yolculuğa başlama aşamalarını birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol yükü taşımanın yanında yükselme, havalanma ve yüklenerek ayrılma anlamlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yükü taşıma eyleminden çok onu taşıyacak güce sahip olmayı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir yükün ağırlığını karşılayacak gücü ve taşıma yeterliğini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Taşıma yeterliği ortak olsa da bu kol fiilî taşıma ve yerden yükselme yönlerine açılır; komşu kol güç yetirme sınırında kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol yük üstlenmeyi, kuşun havalanmasını ve yolcuların yüklenerek ayrılmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol kişinin oturduğu yerden kalkmasını ve bir nesneyi bulunduğu yerden kaldırmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da aşağıdaki veya durağan bir konumdan kalkma ve hareket başlangıcını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol yükselmeyi taşıma ve yolculukla bağlar; komşu kol bedensel olarak ayağa kalkma ve nesneyi yerinden kaldırma çevresindedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kolda yolculuk anlamı yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılmasıyla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yol üzerinde ilerlemeyi ve belirli bir hedefe doğru seyahat etmeyi genel olarak bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlama durumunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol başlangıçtaki yüklenme ve kalkış anını anlatır; komşu kol yolculuğun kendisini ve hedefe doğru ilerlemeyi çekirdek edinir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; taşıma gücü, yerden kalkma ve yolculuğa başlama komşuları bu kolun üç kurucu yönünü en az yinelemeyle açıklar.
branches.what_is_ar: حمل الشيء واحتماله، وارتفاعه أو نهوضه، وارتحال القوم ظاعنين
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد القلة العددية، ولا قلة الجبل، ولا الرعدة
branches.source_phrase_ar: أقل الجرة أطاق حملها؛ استقلت السماء ارتفعت؛ استقل القوم مضوا وارتحلوا (sihah)؛ أقل الرجل الشيء واستقله إذا احتمله؛ استقل الطائر إذا نهض للطيران؛ استقل النبات أناف؛ استقل القوم إذا احتملوا ظاعنين؛ أقلت سحابا ثقالا أي حملت؛ قل إذا رفع وقل إذا علا (tahdhib)؛ أقلت سحابا ثقالا أي احتملته؛ أقللت كذا وجدته قليل المحمل (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duygusal nedeni ve bedensel titremeyi birlikte taşıyan bütün kol için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Korku veya öfke koşulunu ve bunun doğurduğu bedensel titremeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun yol açtığı kısa ve istemsiz bedensel titreme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Korkuya bağlı istemsiz titreme ve silkiniş hissini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Titremenin kişiyi birden tutan belirgin bir durum olarak anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Titremenin kişiyi tutan bedensel bir olay olarak sunuluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öfkenin bedensel titreme halinde dışa vurulduğu kişi bağlamlarına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Öfke nedenini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan titremeyi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol titremenin korku veya öfkeden doğmasını anlam sınırının parçası yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol insandaki titreme veya silkinişi belirli bir duygusal nedenle sınırlamaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da insan bedeninde ortaya çıkan titreme veya silkinişi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bedensel olay aynıdır; bu kol korku ve öfke koşulunu taşırken komşu kart neden bakımından daha genel kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol korkunun yanında öfkeyi de titremenin belirleyici nedeni olarak içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol hastalık, gevşeklik, yumuşaklık ve korkaklıkla ilişkili titremeleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da özellikle korku sırasında insanda görülen titreme ve ürpermede örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Korkuya bağlı kullanımda yakınlaşırlar; bu kol öfkeyi ekler, komşu kol ise hastalık ve bedensel gevşeklik gibi başka nedenlere açılır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; genel insan titremesi ve nedenleri daha geniş ürperme alanı, bu kolun kişi ve duygu sınırını en iyi gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Neden olunan hareketi ve nesnenin ortaya çıkan kararsız sallanmasını birlikte kapsayan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket ettirme nedenini ve sabit kalamayan nesnenin sallanma sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin bir nesneyi hareket ettirerek onun oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dışarıdan uygulanan hareketi ve nesnenin sarsılması sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin gevşeklik veya kararsızlık nedeniyle bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmadığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sabit kalamama ile düzensiz sallanma durumunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sallanan veya oynayan nesnenin çıkardığı sesin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin genel bir ses değil, hareketten doğan işitsel belirti oluşunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol nesnenin oynatılması, yerinde duramaması ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem çekirdeğiyle ondan türeyen tapınılan varlık anlamının birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tapınma eylemini ve bu eylemin yöneldiği varlığı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin tapınma eylemini veya kendini tapınmaya vermesini bildiren eylem bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylem olarak tapınma çekirdeğini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun kendisine tapındığı varlık veya nesneden söz edilen ad bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tapınmanın yöneldiği varlık veya nesne anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir varlığın başkalarına tapınma konusu olarak benimsetilmesini anlatan ettirgen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir varlığı tapınma konusu durumuna getirme işlemini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kimi toplulukların tapındığı için bu adla anılan güneş

error_profile.preserves: Tapınılan varlık anlamını kısa ve doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Tapınma eylemini, kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini ve tapınılır kılma işlemini karşılamaz.
error_profile.collision: Yalnızca belirli bir varlık türünü adlandırdığı için bütün dalın karşılığı sanılabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal eylem ve yaklaşma yönünde yoğunlaşırken bu dal aynı çekirdekten tapınılan varlık ile ettirgen kılma anlamlarını da türetir; bu yüzden yalnızca eylem bağlamında yakınlaşırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tapınmayı korku, inziva veya aşırı uygulama koşuluna bağlamaz ve tapınılan varlığı da adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Korkudan doğan, inziva veya ek yüklenme biçimindeki özel bir tapınma yaşayışını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal genel tapınma çekirdeğini ve ondan türeyen varlık anlamlarını kapsar; komşu dal ise korku, inziva ve olağanın üstündeki uygulamalarla sınırlı özel bir yaşayışı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Genel tapınma eylemini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yaratıcıya özgü adı ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek ve ant kalıplarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: Yaratıcıya özgü ad ve kullanım kalıpları

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.
